name: print-social-78-percent-productivity-post-with-blue-line-chart-over-numeral
title: 'Productivity increases by 78%' post with a glowing blue line chart crossing a huge numeral
whatItIs: A portrait black post with a white X logo, a single centred sentence, a huge blue '78%' partly hidden behind a glowing blue wave line chart with white data points and vertical drop lines, and a blue gradient fill below.
whatItMeans: Data-driven and dramatic; the chart literally rises through the stat.
techniques: Let a line chart overlap a giant numeral.
Mark data points with white dots and drop lines.
Fill under the curve with a gradient.
Keep the text to one sentence.

A single number shown very large.
